E-Commerce Pipeline Automation

Automated data pipelines and marketing-data optimization for an e-commerce platform's decision-making.

Data EngineeringAutomationSQL

Overview

At Sabke Zandegi Khallagh (Mihan GP), marketing and sales data was being pulled and joined by hand ahead of every planning cycle. This project replaced that manual process with a scheduled pipeline.

Pipeline step

Each run pulls the latest orders, joins them against the campaign attribution table, and writes a refreshed summary table the marketing team’s dashboards read from directly:

INSERT INTO marketing_summary
SELECT
    o.campaign_id,
    COUNT(o.order_id)      AS orders,
    SUM(o.total_amount)    AS revenue,
    DATE_TRUNC('day', o.created_at) AS day
FROM orders o
JOIN campaign_attribution c ON c.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY o.campaign_id, day;

Result

Reporting turnaround for the marketing team went from an end-of-week manual pull to a same-day refreshed dashboard, freeing up the time that had previously gone into assembling the numbers by hand.
